title: Evidence Debt: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, deterministic simulation, canonical synthetic data, and a frozen age-stratified observation of 200 merged Argo CD pull requests and 30 releases. Version 1.2.0 selects four 50-PR cohorts by mergedAt, resolves GitHub issue tokens, reports authorship and change-type strata, adds a seeded 50-PR manual audit, and adds explicit data/code availability. The observation establishes missing external issue linkage under a declared schema; it does not establish inadequate intent documentation, temporal decay, Evidence Debt magnitude, reconstruction cost, or industrial prevalence.
